# PVInstance

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- **Not creatable**: `Instance.new` refuses it
- **Abstract**: it exists to be inherited from

The base of everything with a position and orientation in the world: a pivot to move it by, and an offset saying where that pivot sits. BasePart, Model and Camera are the three.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PivotOffset` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | Where this object's pivot sits relative to the object itself; the identity puts it at the centre. Set it to a hinge edge and PivotTo rotates about that edge. |

## Methods

### `GetPivot(): CFrame`

This object's pivot in world space.

### `PivotTo(target: CFrame)`

Moves this object so its pivot lands on target. A Model moves every part under it and keeps their relative layout; a BasePart or Camera moves itself.
